title: pre cut parchment sheets
text: pre cut parchment sheets. It's super convenient to have these on hand.  Fits most of the pans I use regularly.  The dispenser part is little crappy - pulls more than one out - can't put any back in - but I think once I get a few more used, dispensing will become more accurate and useful.  As of now, I am happy with my purchase - but I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: SMARTAKE 9x13 Inches Parchment Paper Sheets, 480Pcs Pre-cut Parchment Paper for Baking, Non-Stick Quarter Sheet Baking Paper, for Kitchens Air Fryer Steaming Bread Cake Cookie Meat Pizza (Unbleached)
features: Precut Baking Sheets Paper: Are you tired of cutting curly parchment paper? Our precut parchment sheets can let you get rid of cutting parchment anymore, the sheets lay flat on the baking tray and will not curl.
Food Grade Parchment Paper: 480 pieces non-toxic and food grade baking sheets are perfect for baking, grilling, frying and steaming, can resist temperature up to 450°F.
Non-Stick Parchment Sheets: Cookies can easily slide off the baking tray and the bread won’t stick on it.
No Curly Baking Paper: We provide a rectangular packaging box, you will receive the sheets without folding, and the thin packing box won’t occupy your space.
Suitable size: designed for 9x13 inches baking sheet, clean cut edges, and perfect size make for a much faster and easier cooking and baking experience in kitchen.
